question: How does cp-07 release, flag and roll back the two Workers?
diagram:
flowchart LR
  subgraph ci["GitHub Actions · deploy.yml"]
    CK["check · lint · test · types · migration guard"]
    PV["preview · versions upload on PRs"]
    DP["deploy · on main"]
    MG["migrate · workflow_dispatch only"]
  end
  subgraph dep["scripts/deploy.sh · just deploy"]
    PM["pending D1 migration? stop"]
    WA["wrangler deploy · apps/api"]
    WW["wrangler deploy · apps/web"]
  end
  subgraph live["Cloudflare"]
    HZ["/healthz · version id"]
    FT[("D1 · flags table")]
  end
  subgraph back["Rollback"]
    FO["just flag off NAME"]
    RB["just rollback api or web · wrangler rollback"]
  end
  CK --> PV
  CK --> DP
  DP -- "runs" --> PM
  PM -- "none pending" --> WA
  WA -- "then" --> WW
  WA -- "version_metadata" --> HZ
  DP -- "smoke · curl" --> HZ
  FO -- "GH_REMOTE=1 · SQL" --> FT
  RB -- "previous version id" --> HZ
  MG -. "by hand" .-> FT

steps.caption: CI runs lint, tests, type freshness and a destructive migration guard first.
Pull requests upload a version with no traffic, and main deploys.
deploy.sh stops cold if any D1 migration is pending on remote.
wrangler deploys the api first, then the web Worker that binds to it.
/healthz returns the Workers version id, which is the rollback handle.
Flags live in one D1 table and flip with SQL, with no deploy needed.
Rollback is flag off first, then wrangler rollback to the previous id.
Migrations never run on deploy, and a manual workflow applies them by hand.
